username.heading: Username
username.description: You log in with this name. It is not case-sensitive.
username.label: Username
username.invalidError: Please use 3 to 50 characters: letters, digits, dots, hyphens or underscores.

password.heading: Change password
password.description: For security, you need to enter your current password. After the change you are logged out on all other devices.

problems.tooShort: The new password must have at least 8 characters.
problems.tooLong: The new password is too long.
problems.unchanged: The new password must differ from the current one.

buffer.heading: Buffer time between appointments
buffer.description: Minimum gap that has to stay free between two appointments when creating or moving them, e.g. for travel and material.
buffer.label: Buffer time in minutes
buffer.invalidError: Please enter a whole number from 0 to 1440.

errors.invalidInput: The input is invalid. Please check it and try again.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many failed attempts. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.generic: The change could not be saved. Please try again.
